props.heading: The spending gap: the AI+1 touchpoints report puts EdTech professional developme
props.body: Teachers are expected to adopt AI-assisted pedagogy with a fraction of the support doctors receive when adopting new clinical tools. That gap is real — and working around it requires a self-directed practice plan.
props.evidenceNote: AI+1 Touchpoints T6 — $847/teacher/year EdTech PD; 62% feel unprepared. Sourced finding.

props.heading: The practice plan: one recipe per week from this season.
props.body: Four weeks, four recipes: Monday lesson plan, differentiation, exit ticket diagnostic, the hinge-skill assignment audit. By week four you have calibration data — you know what Claude does well for your subject and grade, and where you always need to add your own judgment.
